Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread the Theudebert I Wikipedia page and incorrectly stated that Theudebert I was the son of Clovis I rather than Theuderic I. This conflated grandfather with father, contradicting the source just retrieved (which clearly said Theudebert I was the son of Theuderic I). As a result, the Planner finalized the wrong father-in-law (Clovis I) despite earlier correct reasoning indicating Theuderic I.
